Greek note 1 and Greek text in the body are copied as far as legible; the accents in the note are uncertain. Note 2 is badly faded: the bracketed fragments are uncertain and the sense of the first and last clauses could not be read. The Senec. note carries no mark in the text and is placed at the nearest line. The text "ufcujufque" and "populus aliquis sine turpis" follow the scan as printed. Catchword "Irenæi," is at the right below the last line.
